items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Because Basie was with Gonzelle White then, you know.

ctx.x: Oklahoma. Pritchard, Oklahoma. Trees. Oh, it was a drag. When I think of that shit that happened down there.

And I was also there after that show broke up... See, we left... When we got from the South there, we come to Kansas City, and we played at the Eighteenth Street Theatre. That's when Basie stole my saxophone player and my banjo player. Because Basie was with Gonzelle White then, you know. I looked up, and he got both of them and gone!
